# Flag reference

<!-- Generated by tools/flagdoc from cmd/remotesigner/flags. Do not edit; run `make docs`. -->

```
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] migrate [migrate flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] randao-state reset --key <id> [reset flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] import --from <file> [import flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] export --to <file> [--keys <id>,...] [export flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] watermark-repair --epoch <epoch> --slot <slot> [repair flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus [consensus flags] set-high-watermark (--epoch <epoch> --slot <slot> | --remove) [flags]
remotesigner [global flags] consensus keystore verify --file <keystore> --password-file <file>
```

Every flag can also be set:

- in the environment, as `REMOTESIGNER_<NAME>` for a global flag and `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_<NAME>` for a
  consensus flag (the flag name or any alias in upper case, dashes as underscores);
- in the YAML file given by `--config-file`, under its bare name. Consensus flags may sit at the top level or in a
  `consensus:` section. A list flag takes a YAML list. Unknown keys are rejected.

Precedence: command line, then environment, then config file, then default. Booleans are written `--flag`,
`--flag=true` or `--flag=false`; `--flag false` does not work. Exit codes: 2 for usage errors (including a
missing `--network` and an invalid config file), 1 when the signer refuses to start or fails.

## Global flags

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config-file` | none | none | unset | YAML file of flag values: bare flag names, with an optional consensus: section. Unknown keys are rejected. |
| `--data-path` | `REMOTESIGNER_DATA_PATH` | `data-path` | unset | Directory for the generated token files, the slashing-protection store and the ports file |
| `--key-config-path`, `--key-store-path` | `REMOTESIGNER_KEY_CONFIG_PATH`, `REMOTESIGNER_KEY_STORE_PATH` | `key-config-path` | unset | Directory of key-config files (\*.yaml or \*.yml; types file-raw and file-keystore); unset loads none |
| `--strict-file-permissions` | `REMOTESIGNER_STRICT_FILE_PERMISSIONS` | `strict-file-permissions` | `true` | Refuse secret files (password files, key-config files with a seed) that their group or other users can read; false loads them with a warning |
| `--reload-timeout` | `REMOTESIGNER_RELOAD_TIMEOUT` | `reload-timeout` | `60` | Minutes a POST /reload may load keys; the sources not loaded by then keep their previous keys. The startup load is not bounded. |
| `--signer-load-parallelism` | `REMOTESIGNER_SIGNER_LOAD_PARALLELISM` | `signer-load-parallelism` | `0 (from the memory limit)` | Keystore decrypts with the standard KDF that may run at once; 0 sizes the Argon2id budget from GOMEMLIMIT, the cgroup limit or half the RAM |
| `--logging`, `-l` | `REMOTESIGNER_LOGGING`, `REMOTESIGNER_L` | `logging` | `INFO` | Log level: OFF, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE or ALL |
| `--logging-format`, `--log-format` | `REMOTESIGNER_LOGGING_FORMAT`, `REMOTESIGNER_LOG_FORMAT` | `logging-format` | `text` | Log format: text or json |
| `--log-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_LOG_FILE` | `log-file` | unset | Write logs to this file instead of standard error |
| `--http-listen-host` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_LISTEN_HOST` | `http-listen-host` | `127.0.0.1` | Host the API listens on. A non-loopback host turns on the remote-listener fail-safes. |
| `--http-listen-port` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_LISTEN_PORT` | `http-listen-port` | `9000` | Port the API listens on; 0 picks a free port (see the ports file) |
| `--http-host-allowlist` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_HOST_ALLOWLIST` | `http-host-allowlist` | `localhost,127.0.0.1,::1` | Host header names the API accepts (DNS-rebinding defence); \* or all accepts any, none refuses all |
| `--http-auth-mode` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_AUTH_MODE` | `http-auth-mode` | `token` | API authentication: token (the sign token), mtls (a client certificate grants the sign scope), token+mtls (both) or none (loopback listeners only). Admin routes always need the admin token. |
| `--http-auth-token-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE` | `http-auth-token-file` | unset | Sign-scope bearer token file (default \<data-path>/auth-token, generated 0600 when missing; re-read on SIGHUP) |
| `--http-admin-token-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE` | `http-admin-token-file` | unset | Admin-scope bearer token file (default \<data-path>/admin-token, generated 0600 when missing; re-read on SIGHUP). Admin routes exist only with an admin token. |
| `--http-max-connections` | `REMOTESIGNER_HTTP_MAX_CONNECTIONS` | `http-max-connections` | `1024` | Maximum open API connections; further connections wait until one closes |
| `--idle-connection-timeout-seconds` | `REMOTESIGNER_IDLE_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `idle-connection-timeout-seconds` | `120` | Seconds a kept-alive API connection may stay idle |
| `--access-logs-enabled` | `REMOTESIGNER_ACCESS_LOGS_ENABLED` | `access-logs-enabled` | `false` | Log every API request at INFO (route, status, duration; never paths or bodies) |
| `--tls-cert-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_CERT_FILE` | `tls-cert-file` | unset | PEM certificate chain the API serves over TLS 1.3, with --tls-key-file (re-read on SIGHUP) |
| `--tls-key-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_KEY_FILE` | `tls-key-file` | unset | PEM private key of --tls-cert-file |
| `--tls-keystore-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_KEYSTORE_FILE` | `tls-keystore-file` | unset | PKCS#12 keystore with the API's TLS key and certificate chain, instead of PEM; with --tls-keystore-password-file (re-read on SIGHUP) |
| `--tls-keystore-password-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE` | `tls-keystore-password-file` | unset | File whose first line is the password of --tls-keystore-file |
| `--tls-generate-self-signed` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_GENERATE_SELF_SIGNED` | `tls-generate-self-signed` | `false` | Serve TLS with a self-signed ECDSA P-256 certificate, generated 0600 into \<data-path>/tls/ on first start for the --http-host-allowlist names and reused after; a configured certificate takes precedence |
| `--tls-known-clients-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_KNOWN_CLIENTS_FILE` | `tls-known-clients-file` | unset | Client certificates the mtls modes accept: lines of "\<label> \<SHA-256 fingerprint>" (Web3Signer's format; re-read on SIGHUP) |
| `--tls-client-ca-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_TLS_CLIENT_CA_FILE` | `tls-client-ca-file` | unset | PEM CAs whose client certificates the mtls modes accept; the system roots are never used (re-read on SIGHUP) |
| `--metrics-enabled` | `REMOTESIGNER_METRICS_ENABLED` | `metrics-enabled` | `false` | Serve Prometheus metrics at /metrics on a separate listener |
| `--metrics-host` | `REMOTESIGNER_METRICS_HOST` | `metrics-host` | `127.0.0.1` | Host the metrics listener binds |
| `--metrics-port` | `REMOTESIGNER_METRICS_PORT` | `metrics-port` | `9001` | Port the metrics listener binds; 0 picks a free port (see the ports file) |
| `--metrics-host-allowlist` | `REMOTESIGNER_METRICS_HOST_ALLOWLIST` | `metrics-host-allowlist` | `localhost,127.0.0.1` | Host header names the metrics listener accepts; \* or all accepts any, none refuses all |
| `--metrics-auth-token-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE` | `metrics-auth-token-file` | unset | Bearer token file the metrics listener requires (generated 0600 when missing; re-read on SIGHUP); unset leaves /metrics open |
| `--disable-core-dumps` | `REMOTESIGNER_DISABLE_CORE_DUMPS` | `disable-core-dumps` | `true` | On Linux, make the process non-dumpable (no core dumps, no ptrace or /proc memory reads by other processes) and set its core-file limit to 0 |
| `--mlock-all` | `REMOTESIGNER_MLOCK_ALL` | `mlock-all` | `false` | On Linux, lock all process memory so that keys are never swapped out (needs CAP_IPC_LOCK or an unlimited RLIMIT_MEMLOCK; refused otherwise) |

## Consensus flags

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--network` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_NETWORK` | `network` or `consensus.network` | unset | Required. A built-in network name (minimal, end-to-end or e2e, end-to-end-mainnet, interop) or a qrysm-format config YAML file |
| `--network-genesis-validators-root` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_NETWORK_GENESIS_VALIDATORS_ROOT` | `network-genesis-validators-root` or `consensus.network-genesis-validators-root` | unset | Genesis validators root, 0x + 64 hex characters; must agree with every other source |
| `--network-genesis-time` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_NETWORK_GENESIS_TIME` | `network-genesis-time` or `consensus.network-genesis-time` | unset | Genesis time in Unix seconds; must agree with every other source |
| `--network-genesis-state` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_NETWORK_GENESIS_STATE` | `network-genesis-state` or `consensus.network-genesis-state` | unset | SSZ genesis state; its first 64 bytes give the genesis time, the genesis validators root and the fork |
| `--slashing-protection-enabled` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_ENABLED` | `slashing-protection-enabled` or `consensus.slashing-protection-enabled` | `true` | Slashing protection (bbolt store at \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db). false is allowed only when every listener is loopback. |
| `--key-manager-api-enabled` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_KEY_MANAGER_API_ENABLED` | `key-manager-api-enabled` or `consensus.key-manager-api-enabled` | `false` | Accepted for Web3Signer compatibility; requires an admin token. This release has no keymanager API. |
| `--voluntary-exit-signing-enabled` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_VOLUNTARY_EXIT_SIGNING_ENABLED` | `voluntary-exit-signing-enabled` or `consensus.voluntary-exit-signing-enabled` | `false` | Sign VOLUNTARY_EXIT requests; refused with 403 ARTIFACT_TYPE_DISABLED otherwise |
| `--registration-fee-recipient-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_REGISTRATION_FEE_RECIPIENT_FILE` | `registration-fee-recipient-file` or `consensus.registration-fee-recipient-file` | unset | YAML list of {key, fee_recipient} pins: a VALIDATOR_REGISTRATION for a pinned key must carry its pinned fee recipient |
| `--signing-clock-skew-slots` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SIGNING_CLOCK_SKEW_SLOTS` | `signing-clock-skew-slots` or `consensus.signing-clock-skew-slots` | `1` | Slots a slot-scoped request may lie ahead of the wall clock (when genesis time is known) |
| `--selection-proof-signing` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SELECTION_PROOF_SIGNING` | `selection-proof-signing` or `consensus.selection-proof-signing` | `deterministic` | Signing mode of AGGREGATION_SLOT and SYNC_COMMITTEE_SELECTION_PROOF: deterministic or hedged; other types are always hedged |
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | `slashing-protection-db-url` or `consensus.slashing-protection-db-url` | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--slashing-protection-db-migrate` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_MIGRATE` | `slashing-protection-db-migrate` or `consensus.slashing-protection-db-migrate` | `false` | Upgrade an older slashing-protection store to this release's schema before starting (a backup \<file>.v\<old>.bak is written first) |
| `--slashing-protection-pruning-epochs-to-keep` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_PRUNING_EPOCHS_TO_KEEP` | `slashing-protection-pruning-epochs-to-keep` or `consensus.slashing-protection-pruning-epochs-to-keep` | `512` | Epochs of block and attestation history each validator keeps below its newest record (slots per epoch come from the network); older records are pruned |
| `--slashing-protection-pruning-interval` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_PRUNING_INTERVAL` | `slashing-protection-pruning-interval` or `consensus.slashing-protection-pruning-interval` | `12h0m0s` | Time between two slashing-protection pruning runs, as a duration such as 12h or 90m (Web3Signer's bare number of hours is refused); the first runs at startup |
| `--randao-max-layers` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_MAX_LAYERS` | `randao-max-layers` or `consensus.randao-max-layers` | `1048576` | Onion layers searched from x_0 when locating a RANDAO commitment; a commitment deeper in a longer onion is unknown |
| `--randao-reorg-window` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_REORG_WINDOW` | `randao-reorg-window` or `consensus.randao-reorg-window` | `1024` | Layers above a key's released frontier searched for a re-reveal before the slow-path scan |
| `--randao-full-scan-min-interval` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_FULL_SCAN_MIN_INTERVAL` | `randao-full-scan-min-interval` or `consensus.randao-full-scan-min-interval` | `SECONDS_PER_SLOT` | Minimum time between two slow-path RANDAO scans of one key (first use, gap advance, deep reorg); sooner gets 429 RANDAO_SCAN_RATE_LIMITED |
| `--randao-new-layer-burst` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_NEW_LAYER_BURST` | `randao-new-layer-burst` or `consensus.randao-new-layer-burst` | `3` | Tokens in each key's RANDAO new-layer bucket: frontier-moving reveals allowed in a burst |
| `--randao-new-layer-refill-epochs` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_NEW_LAYER_REFILL_EPOCHS` | `randao-new-layer-refill-epochs` or `consensus.randao-new-layer-refill-epochs` | `1` | Epochs per new-layer token refill; 0 turns the bucket off. Networks with fewer than about 4 x SLOTS_PER_EPOCH validators should raise the burst or use 0. |
| `--randao-protection-required` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_RANDAO_PROTECTION_REQUIRED` | `randao-protection-required` or `consensus.randao-protection-required` | `false` | Refuse to start when RANDAO frontiers would be kept in memory only (--slashing-protection-enabled=false) |
| `--keystores-path` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_KEYSTORES_PATH` | `keystores-path` or `consensus.keystores-path` | unset | Directory of keystores to load: every non-hidden \*.json file in it (deposit CLI or qrysm keystore v1) |
| `--keystores-password-file` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_KEYSTORES_PASSWORD_FILE` | `keystores-password-file` or `consensus.keystores-password-file` | unset | File holding the password of every keystore in --keystores-path; not with --keystores-passwords-path |
| `--keystores-passwords-path` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_KEYSTORES_PASSWORDS_PATH` | `keystores-passwords-path` or `consensus.keystores-passwords-path` | unset | Directory of password files, \<name>.txt for keystore \<name>.json; not with --keystores-password-file |

## Offline store commands

These subcommands work on the bbolt slashing-protection store while the signer is stopped (bbolt allows one process
per file; they refuse a store that a running signer holds). They read `--data-path` for the default store
location. Their flags are not read from the config file; `--slashing-protection-db-url` may also be given to
`consensus` itself, on the command line, in the environment or in the config file. `import`, `export`
and `set-high-watermark` also read `--network` and its genesis flags from `consensus`, for the
genesis validators root: `import` and `set-high-watermark` bind a store that has none to it, and `export`
names it in the file of such a store. The history commands are described in
[`../operations/migration.md`](../operations/migration.md).

### consensus migrate

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |

### consensus randao-state reset

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--key` | none | none | unset | Required. The key whose RANDAO frontier is cleared: its 0x public key or 0x sha256 of it |

### consensus import

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--from` | none | none | unset | Required. The EIP-3076 interchange file (format version 5) to import |

### consensus export

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--to` | none | none | unset | Required. The EIP-3076 interchange file to write; an existing file is replaced |
| `--keys` | none | none | unset | Export only these validators: 0x public keys or 0x sha256 identifiers, comma-separated or repeated |

### consensus watermark-repair

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--epoch` | none | none | unset | Required. Raise every validator's attestation source and target low watermarks to this epoch |
| `--slot` | none | none | unset | Required. Raise every validator's block low watermark to this slot |

### consensus set-high-watermark

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--epoch` | none | none | unset | Required unless --remove. The high watermark's epoch: attestations with a source or target epoch at or above it are refused |
| `--slot` | none | none | unset | Required unless --remove. The high watermark's slot: blocks at or above it are refused |
| `--remove` | none | none | `false` | Remove the high watermark instead of setting one |

### consensus disable-validator

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--slashing-protection-db-url` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_SLASHING_PROTECTION_DB_URL` | none | unset | Slashing-protection store as bolt:///absolute/path/file.db (default \<data-path>/slashing-protection.db) |
| `--key` | none | none | unset | Required. The key to disable: its 0x public key or 0x sha256 of it |

`consensus disable-validator` persists `enabled=false` for a key, which then gets 412
`VALIDATOR_DISABLED` for blocks, attestations and new RANDAO layers. Reloads never disable a key. See
[`../operations/reload.md`](../operations/reload.md#5-disabling-a-validator).

## Keystore commands

`consensus keystore verify` decrypts one keystore with its password file (`--file`, `--password-file`), or a
keystore directory as the signer loads it (`--keystores-path` with `--keystores-password-file` or
`--keystores-passwords-path`), through the signer's keystore decryptor, policy and file-permission rule, and
checks that each keystore's pubkey is the key its seed derives. It prints each key's identifier and exits 0, or
names the refusals and exits 1. It needs no network, store or running signer. Its own flags read no environment
variables, so that a signer's `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_KEYSTORES_*` settings do not apply to it; the global
`--strict-file-permissions` and `--signer-load-parallelism` do. See
[`../operations/keystores.md`](../operations/keystores.md).

### consensus keystore verify

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | none | none | unset | The keystore to check: qrysm's keystore v1 or a deposit CLI keystore (JSON); with --password-file |
| `--password-file` | none | none | unset | File holding the keystore's password; trailing line breaks are not part of it |
| `--keystores-path` | none | none | unset | Directory of keystores to load: every non-hidden \*.json file in it (deposit CLI or qrysm keystore v1) |
| `--keystores-password-file` | none | none | unset | File holding the password of every keystore in --keystores-path; not with --keystores-passwords-path |
| `--keystores-passwords-path` | none | none | unset | Directory of password files, \<name>.txt for keystore \<name>.json; not with --keystores-password-file |

## Override flags

These flags are hidden from `--help`. Each one accepts a risk that a startup fail-safe otherwise refuses on a
non-loopback listener. None of them can re-enable a disabled slashing protection there: that refusal has no override.

### Global

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--Xallow-plaintext-token-auth` | `REMOTESIGNER_XALLOW_PLAINTEXT_TOKEN_AUTH` | `Xallow-plaintext-token-auth` | `false` | Allow bearer tokens over plaintext HTTP on a non-loopback listener |

### Consensus

| Flag | Environment | Config file | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--Xallow-unknown-genesis-time` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_XALLOW_UNKNOWN_GENESIS_TIME` | `Xallow-unknown-genesis-time` or `consensus.Xallow-unknown-genesis-time` | `false` | Allow a non-loopback listener without a genesis time (wall-clock bounds off) |
| `--Xallow-gvr-tofu` | `REMOTESIGNER_CONSENSUS_XALLOW_GVR_TOFU` | `Xallow-gvr-tofu` or `consensus.Xallow-gvr-tofu` | `false` | Allow a non-loopback listener to pin the genesis validators root on first use |
